description: Shared Renovate settings for every junkerderprovinz repository. A repository extends this and keeps only its own exceptions.

packageRules.description: Node stays on 24 until 26 is tested. This covers the node image, node-version in setup-node (looked up as actions/node-versions), .nvmrc, engines and @types/node.
GitHub Actions merge once every check is green. Renovate merges them itself, since main has no required checks and GitHub's own auto-merge would not wait.
Docker digests: a new pin or a fresh build of the same tag merges once every check is green. A new tag stays open for review.
Go modules: minor, patch and digest updates share one weekly PR, majors stay separate.
npm: minor and patch updates share one weekly PR, majors stay separate.
GlimStone's packages must share one version, or the app bundles two copies of core with separate stores.
A compose file is for people to copy, so it follows our own latest tag instead of a digest that goes stale with every build.
